sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 12 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPCX、SPY、RKLB、SNDK、MU。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • SpaceX (SPCX), the largest IPO in history, continued to strengthen on its first trading day: Issue price $135, raising approximately $75 billion, IPO valuation $1.75 trillion; opened this morning at ~$151 and surged all the way to $176.49, trading at $172.72 as of 13:25 ET (+28% vs. issue price), with market cap around $2.2-2.3 trillion, already surpassing Amazon to enter the global top six by market cap. CFRA issued the first analyst rating: Sell, target price $115. Musk’s net worth broke through $1.1 trillion, making him the first trillionaire in human history. Intraday, the stock was pinned near $165 by a giant sell wall for an hour, with the community complaining about the “most boring IPO ever,” before breaking out again in the afternoon to set a new intraday high.
  • Space stocks were massacred, with SPCX draining liquidity from the entire market: SPCE -29% (yesterday’s “bought the wrong ticker” mistaken funds reversed), ASTS -13%, LUNR -11%, RKLB fell below $100 intraday before rebounding to $106 (-7.5%); meanwhile, overall market volume shrank dramatically, with SPY at $742.5 (+0.65%) pinned in the 741-742.5 range, QQQ at $723.4 (+0.94%), and 0DTE premiums on both sides crushed by theta and falling IV.
  • U.S.-Iran talks advanced further: Pakistan’s prime minister said the two sides had reached a “final, agreed upon text” on a ceasefire agreement, while Trump said the agreement could be signed in Europe over the weekend, with Vance attending; however, neither U.S. nor Iranian officials have confirmed a final text, and the terms have not been disclosed. The news pushed the market into a V-shaped rebound from the morning low (SPY intraday low $735), but the community believes “the good news has been shouted a hundred times already,” with diminishing marginal impact.
  • A standalone bull market in semiconductors/memory: SNDK broke above $2000 to hit an ATH (+7%, up about 10x in one year), STX +8%, INTC +8%, ARM +10%, AMD +6.3%, NBIS +7.4%; MU touched $1012 intraday before repeatedly battling around the $1000 level (+0.6%). MSFT (-0.6%) and AMZN (-1.8%) continued to bleed, with the community joking that funds are rotating out of old-school megacaps into “semis + memory + Elon.”
  • Next week’s 6/17 FOMC will be Warsh’s debut: The market broadly expects rates to remain unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%, but the probability of a hike this year has risen above 50%, and Warsh may weaken forward guidance or even take a knife to the dot plot; WSB is already circulating a panic narrative that “next week’s rate hike will be brutal” (which does not align with the mainstream expectation of “standing pat”).

社区氛围：今天的WSB就像一场以SPCX为中心的巨大情绪过山车——多头展示了巨额IPO分配利润，并嘲笑“Reddit集体讨厌的股票显然只会上涨”，而空头则等待着“不可避免的拉动”，面对2.2万亿美元的荒谬估值，而收入为180亿美元，年度亏损为49亿美元。总体而言，人们的情绪是欣快和虚无主义的混合体：“狂欢节般的看涨，理性的看跌。”与此同时，SPY被钉住导致期权双杀，导致许多短线交易者在大绿日亏损，引发大量不满。

恐惧/贪婪估计：贪婪 75/100。 FOMO 占主导地位（追逐 SPCX 和 SNDK 的情况很普遍），但“有史以来最大的泡沫”和“周一崩盘”等末日叙事继续高频率出现——典型的“边买边说垃圾话”。

情绪与实际价格走势：社区几周来一直看跌 SPCX 的首日表现，但结果却上涨了 28%，使“反向 Reddit”再次成为当天最大的叙事；与此同时，社会对大盘的极端期望“要么750，要么735”也未能实现。指数温和上涨，但个股分化严重，让大多数人受到两面打击。
